text: dsh-claude-live 让 DSH 将完整任务委派给独立上下文中的 Claude Code，并把执行步骤实时显示在会话视图中。工具接收任务、工作目录、权限模式和模型选项，返回最终结果及事件数、工具调用数和耗时统计；遇到启动失败、超时、取消或缺少结果时会返回错误。进度以单条动态行呈现，包含近期步骤和计数。

dsh-claude-live delegates tasks to Claude Code and streams progress into DSH. Inputs include a task, working directory, permission mode, and optional model. It returns the result and run statistics, or an error on startup failure, timeout, cancellation, or missing results.
想让 DSH 把一项独立任务交给 Claude Code 完成。
怎么在 DSH 会话里实时看到 Claude 执行到哪一步？
让 DSH 调用本机的 Claude Code 处理代码任务。
我希望委派子任务时还能看到工具调用进度。
能不能指定 Claude Code 在哪个项目目录里工作？
如何给委派任务选择模型或只读权限？
Delegate a standalone coding task from DSH to Claude Code.
Show Claude Code progress live inside my DSH session.
dsh-claude-live 的功能「运行 Claude Code 子任务」：工具接收完整任务及可选工作目录、权限模式和模型，启动 Claude CLI 并返回最终结果与运行统计。
dsh-claude-live 的功能「实时展示执行进度」：将 Claude 的文本和工具调用事件整理为摘要，通过会话事件更新单条进度行，并保留最近步骤。
dsh-claude-live 的功能「限制运行时间并响应取消」：运行达到配置时限或收到取消信号时终止子进程组，并返回对应失败状态。
dsh-claude-live 的功能「解析流式结果并清洗输出」：逐行解析 CLI 的 NDJSON 输出，忽略非 JSON 行，并将结果转换为严格可序列化的 JSON。
dsh-claude-live 需要本机已安装且完成认证的 Claude Code CLI；插件会启动 claude 子进程执行任务。

dsh-claude-live README · dsh-claude-live：Run **Claude Code** headless as a subagent from the DeepSeek Harness, with its
steps streaming into the session view **while it works**.

One tool. One child process. No registry, no role library, no continuable
sessions.

dsh-claude-live README · Why this exists：- **Polling is a lie.** `subagent_progress` only reports what the child has
  already flushed; between polls you see nothing, and the model burns turns
  asking. Progress has to be *pushed*, not sampled.
- **Custom events break the viewer.** `dsh-background-agents` writes its own
  `background-agents/fact` event type. The rc.2 persistence read path refuses
  to interpret any event outside `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES`, so the web UI
  cannot replay those sessions at all.

dsh-claude-live README · Why this exists：This plugin pushes progress through an event pair the installed harness
already understands: `tool/code-dispatch-start` / `tool/code-dispatch` — the
same pair the core's own Code Mode bridge uses to log nested sub-calls. Both
are documented as *log-only*: `deriveMessages()` ignores them, so the digest
lines never re-enter model context, but UIs use them for live per-sub-call
state. The digest therefore renders as sub-rows under the still-running
`claude_live` call, exactly like nested tool calls under `run_code`.

dsh-claude-live README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.1-rc.2` or later.
- `claude` on `PATH` (or `~/.local/bin`, `~/.claude/local`, `/usr/local/bin`,
  `/opt/homebrew/bin`), authenticated.
- Node ≥ 18.

dsh-claude-live README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-claude-live
dsh plugin --profile headless add dsh-claude-live   # optional
```

For a local checkout, install the directory into the profile with pnpm and add
the layer yourself:

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add file:/path/to/dsh-claude-live
```

```yaml

dsh-claude-live README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: claude-live
      name: 'dsh-claude-live'
      config:
        timeoutMs: 1800000
```

Restart the harness afterwards. See `TESTPLAN.md` for the full install +
smoke-test sequence.

dsh-claude-live README · Usage：```
claude_live task="Refactor src/calc.js and run its tests" permissionMode="full" cwd="/srv/project"
```

dsh-claude-live README · Usage：| Argument | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `task` | yes | Complete, self-contained prompt. The child does not see this conversation. |
| `cwd` | no | Working directory. Defaults to the harness process directory. |
| `permissionMode` | no | `readonly` → `--permission-mode plan`; `full` → `--dangerously-skip-permissions`; `default` (the default) → Claude's own configuration. |
| `model` | no | `--model` override. Omit for Claude's default. |

dsh-claude-live README · Usage：Returns `{ ok, result, stats: { events, toolCalls, durationMs } }`, or
`{ ok: false, error }` when the CLI could not start, timed out, was cancelled,
or exited without a result event. Every return value is sanitized to strict
lossless JSON (no `undefined`, no `NaN`/`Infinity`/`-0`, no class instances,
no cycles) — the harness rejects anything else.

dsh-claude-live README · Usage：While the run is in flight you see ONE self-updating row under the
`claude_live` call (throttled ≤1/s) — the header tracks the current step,
the body is a rolling window of recent digest lines plus a live counter:

```
claude:Bash · npm test          ← header = current step
▸ claude full: Refactor src/calc.js and run its tests
✱ Reading the module to see what the tests cover
▸ Read: /srv/project/src/calc.js

dsh-claude-live README · Usage：The row settles to `claude:done` when Claude finishes. No row-per-step
stacking — the transcript stays flat, like the Claude Code CLI.

dsh-claude-live README · Config：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `timeoutMs` | `1800000` (30 min) | Hard cap per run. On expiry the child's whole process group gets SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 5s. |
| `command` | auto-detected | Explicit path to the `claude` binary. Used strictly — a bad value fails loudly rather than falling back. |

Cancelling the tool call (`exec.signal`) kills the child the same way.

dsh-claude-live README · Coexistence：Distinct plugin id (`claude-live`) and tool name (`claude_live`), so it runs
alongside `dsh-plugin-product-subagents` without collision.

dsh-claude-live README · Prior art：- [relay-dsh-plugin-claude](https://github.com/yangbobo2021/relay-dsh-plugin-claude) also streams Claude Code activity into the DSH conversation — as a **session backend**: you pick "Claude Code" as the session mode and DSH's own agent loop steps aside. dsh-claude-live is the **subagent shape**: DSH stays the driving agent and delegates, so DeepSeek plans/orchestrates and Claude executes chunks, with both visible in one session.
- [dsh-plugin-product-subagents](https://github.com/shaokeyibb/dsh-plugin-product-subagents) runs Claude as a subagent (richer lifecycle: roles, continuable children) but its trace tool currently fails with "value is not lossless JSON" ([issue #4](https://github.com/shaokeyibb/dsh-plugin-product-subagents/issues/4)), so no live steps.
- [dsh-background-agents](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-background-agents) streams via custom event types the released harness can't replay (needs unreleased core).

dsh-claude-live README · Contributing：Small by design, and there's plenty to do: streaming for **codex** and ACP CLIs as the child, cancellation from the UI, richer digests (diffs, token counts), tests against future dsh releases. Issues and PRs welcome.
